candidates.change_summary: Change the return value from true to false.
Replace the amount calculation in the call from mul_uint256(v[i], 1000000000000000000) to just v[i]
Replace the amount calculation from mul_uint256(v[i], 1000000000000000000) to mul_uint256(v[i], 1)
Remove the require check for msg.sender so anyone can call transfer
Replace caddress with a different address constant (address(0)) so tokens are sent to the zero address
Change 'from' argument to an arbitrary sender address (address(0)) so tokens appear to come from a different source
